# Per-seed world-recreation ground truth, captured from the live BDS 1.26.43 server.
#
# Methodology (PLAN §4 "one fresh world per seed" harness model):
#   For each seed: set `level-seed=<seed>` in server.properties, delete the world
#   under /data/worlds, restart the container, then send `/locate` commands.
#
# These are real captured console lines from 2026-08-12. The village column doubles
# as a control: the generator must predict village EXACTLY for every seed (it does).
# trial_chambers is listed separately because /locate returns its bounding-box CENTRE
# (block % 16 == 9), not the chunk anchor — see golden.rs.
#
# Format per block:
#   seed: <numeric seed>
#   village: <x>, <z>
#   trial_chambers: <x>, <z>
#
seed: 42
village: 680, -376
trial_chambers: 281, 121

seed: 12345
village: -488, 248
trial_chambers: 9, 233

seed: 777
village: -888, -200
trial_chambers: 73, 41

seed: 20240812
village: -856, -904
trial_chambers: 41, 71

#   village: 184, 296
